history.answer: Kidston (GSQ site 479629, 40.7 km south of einasleigh, 255km sw of cairns) is recorded by the Geological Survey of Queensland as an abandoned mine with a large gold size band of 50 - 150 t. Reported production includes 113,804.5 kg gold, about 3.66 Moz troy, 60,887.3 kg silver, and 32,661,055 tonnes of ore from 1915 to 2002. The mine operated in several periods: 1915-1924, 1924-1948, 1950-1963, 1967-1973, 1985-1994, 1994-2001, and 1907-1910. Closure occurred in 2001 with no reason quoted. Ownership and tenure were held by Kidston Gold Mines Limited.

survey.answer: Kidston (Geological Survey of Queensland site 479629) is recorded as an abandoned mine on the Einasleigh 1:100,000 sheet (40.7 km south of einasleigh, 255km sw of cairns.), at -18.8751, 144.1519, located to within 100 m. The survey classes its gold as large, 50-150 t, and also records silver (small), copper (very small), zinc (very small), lead (very small). Within 5 km it records 2 other historical workings, 2 of them with gold; other commodities nearby: copper, lead, silver, zinc. The record gives a size band, not production figures, and holds no owners or closure dates.
sources: Geological Survey of Queensland, MINOCC historical workings (CC BY 4.0, State of Queensland), site 479629: https://spatial-gis.information.qld.gov.au/arcgis/rest/services/GeoscientificInformation/MiningResources/MapServer/16/query?where=site_no%3D479629&outFields=%2A&f=json

structured_record.answer: Kidston (GSQ site 479629, 40.7 km south of einasleigh, 255km sw of cairns) is recorded by the Geological Survey of Queensland as abandoned mine, gold size band large, 50 - 150 t. Reported production: 113,804.5 kg gold, about 3.66 Moz troy (converted here; the survey records 113,804.5 kg) (1915 to 2002, Kidston, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 479629)); 60,887.3 kg silver (1915 to 2002, Kidston, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 479629)); 32,661,055 tonnes ore (1915 to 2002, Kidston, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 479629)). GSQ MINOCC 2017 also lists 5 dated Production rows (gold: 1,309 kg 1915 to 1924; 66,333 kg 1985 to 1994; 30,589 kg 1994 to 1999; 14,865.4 kg 1999 to 2001; 708.1 kg 2001 to 2002); see production. Closure: 2001 (no reason quoted) [Kidston, unknown, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 479629, row 3)]. Years worked per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 479629): 1915-1924, 1994-2001, 1924-1948, 1950-1963, 1985-1994, 1907-1910, 1967-1973. Ownership and tenure: Kidston Gold Mines Limited per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Tenure, SITE_NO 479629). GSQ MINOCC 2017 lists 17 company reports for this site: CR 70, CR 1022, CR 1852, CR 1999, CR 2146, CR 2254, CR 2255, CR 7003, .... Not found: closure reason: the indexed sources give a closure year but quote no reason.
